source: Ghidra FindXRefs + DumpFunctionDecomp on the 22 cluster emitter VAs
scope: the 19 0x01C3..0x01DF cluster opcodes UNOBSERVED in the pcap-opcode-evidence pass's pcap corpus
summary: The cluster is 1.x's social/recruitment subsystem, NOT an action-system cluster (which the pcap-opcode-evidence pass already proved by showing combat c2s is 0x012D). Caller UI control strings disambiguate each opcode into one of 5 subsystems: PcMatching/Recruitment (0x01C3-0x01C8), Mail/Letter (0x01C9/0x01CA/0x01CC), Topic/Forum (0x01D0/0x01D4), Call/Voice (0x01D1/0x01D6), Mail/Compose (0x01D2/0x01D5). 4 vtable-dispatched opcodes (0x01CD, 0x01D9, 0x01DA, 0x01DE) and 3 internal handlers (0x01D7, 0x01D8, 0x01DF) remain unmapped; they are likely the leaf cases of the same social/PcMatching/Mail subsystems.

refinements.refinedRole: C2S - post new PC-Matching (party recruitment) listing. Caller FUN_004BBEA0 reads UI fields Button_Operate, ComboBox_Purpose, ComboBox_GLName, ComboBox_Place, TextBox_Comment, and 4x {ComboBox_Skill_N, CustomControl_RankFrom_N, CustomControl_RankTo_N, CustomControl_NumberOfPeople_N} - a full recruitment posting with 4 skill slots, rank ranges, and headcounts.

C2S - PC-Matching listing view-mode action (apply / view / browse). Caller FUN_004C8390 reads TextBlock_GLName, TextBlock_PersonName, TextBlock_RemainTime + 4x TextBlock_Skill/RankFrom/RankTo/NumberOfPeople - the read-only view side of the listing UI.

C2S - PC-Matching edit-mode toggle. Caller FUN_004C80C0 reads Button_PcMatching_Edit (smoking-gun control name); also invoked from FUN_004C8390 listing-view handler. Transitions between view and edit modes.
C2S - PC-Matching detail view request (another player's posting). Caller FUN_004BF4F0 mirrors FUN_004C8390 layout with TextBlock_ prefix UI controls. Sister of 0x01C4.
C2S - PC-Matching SetAttr/Update on listing fields. Caller FUN_004BD170 uses Action/AttributeName/SetAttr/Update/Index + ValueType pattern + Result_Maker. Sends individual field changes to listing.
C2S - PC-Matching cancel/leave/withdraw. Caller pair spanning both edit (0x004C8390) and view (0x004BF4F0) handlers - common exit/abort path.
C2S - Mail/Letter compose request. Caller FUN_004CB0D0 uses Address_Maker + TextBlock_Total + Button_Add UI - the letter address-list assembly UI. Sister of 0x01CA.
C2S - Mail/Letter attribute set (recipient / subject field update). Caller FUN_004CB0D0 same letter-address handler as 0x01C9; uses Action/AttributeName/SetAttr/Update pattern.
C2S - Letter system small wrapper opcode. Caller FUN_004CA410 is a 2400-char decomp with no distinguishing strings - likely a passthrough or ack within the mail flow.

refinements.callerVa: (no static references; possibly vtable-dispatched or dead code)
refinements.refinedRole: C2S - emitter FUN_004B7E30 has ZERO static references in the binary. Either dead code from earlier dev iterations or called indirectly via a vtable / function pointer table that Ghidra's static xref-search did not resolve. Adjacent in address space to the Mail cluster (0x01C9..0x01CC).
C2S - Topic/Bulletin board list request. Caller FUN_004C0AF0 uses TextBlock_TopicTitle + Call_Maker + Info_Maker UI control pattern - the topic-list / discussion board UI. Sister of 0x01D4.
C2S - Call/Help request. Caller FUN_004C2170 uses Button_Call + TextBlock_Content + Visibility/Visible/Collapsed control pattern - voice-call or help-call request UI. Sister of 0x01D6.

C2S - Mail compose send. Caller FUN_004C2A20 uses Button_Send + ComboBox_Kind + TextBox_Content + TextBox_Header + Kind_Maker + kindtext UI - the actual mail-message-compose / send UI. Sister of 0x01D5.
C2S - Topic/Bulletin board submit/update. Same caller as 0x01D0 (FUN_004C0AF0); paired emit covering the topic-board submit half.
C2S - Mail compose field update. Same caller as 0x01D2 (FUN_004C2A20); paired emit for sending individual compose-field updates.
C2S - Call ack/status. Same caller as 0x01D1 (FUN_004C2170); paired emit for call lifecycle state changes.

C2S - small wrapper. Emitter FUN_00519440 is thunked twice and called once from FUN_0051A4A0 (a 300-char decomp with no distinguishing UI strings). Likely a generic-flag set/clear opcode invoked from multiple subsystems.
C2S - small handler. Caller FUN_00525E50 (900 chars) also emits 0x01DF. No UI control strings to disambiguate further. May be an internal subsystem-handshake pair.

C2S - emitter FUN_004FA750 is referenced only via a vtable slot at 0x00F9E730 (.data section). Called via virtual dispatch from some class's vtable; static xref scan didn't resolve the class. Follow-up: DumpVtableSlots-style script could identify the class.
C2S - emitter FUN_00532A40 is referenced only via a vtable slot at 0x00FA0320 (.data section). Same caveat as 0x01D9.
C2S - emitter FUN_0085E1B0 is referenced only via a vtable slot at 0x01049F08 (.data section). Same caveat as 0x01D9.
C2S - small handler pair. Same caller as 0x01D8 (FUN_00525E50). Internal subsystem-handshake pair.
